radioTitle: 松岭通信 SL-R8 / TRAIN RADIO
radioText:
松岭通信 · SL-R8 列车无线电
SONGLING COMMUNICATIONS · SL-R8 TRAIN RADIO

开关 / POWER：接通或关闭本机。
频道 / CHANNEL：八档预置频道，按调度命令选定。
音量 / VOLUME：六档接收音量，0 为静音。

出乘检查：核对频道、检查听筒归位及引线固定。通话前确认对方身份，使用列车呼号；命令须复诵并确认。
PRE-DEPARTURE: Verify the assigned channel, secure the handset and inspect its lead. Identify both parties, use the train call sign, repeat instructions and obtain confirmation.

供电中断时，旋钮位置仍保留；恢复供电后核对频道。
After a power interruption, check the retained channel setting.

维护：断电后检查固定脚和接插件。勿拉扯听筒引线。
MAINTENANCE: Isolate power before checking mounts and connectors. Do not pull the handset cable.
recordTitle: NF-5K 随车检查记录 / ONBOARD CHECK RECORD
recordText:
NF-5K · 随车检查记录
ONBOARD CHECK RECORD · FORM CW-01

一、出乘前 / BEFORE DEPARTURE
□ 制动与风压：按规定完成试验，核对压力建立与保持。
  BRAKES & AIR: Complete the prescribed brake test; verify pressure build-up and retention.
□ 通信：核对调度指定频道，检查听筒与引线。
  COMMUNICATIONS: Verify the assigned channel, handset and cable.
□ 车门与通道：检查关闭状态及人员通行空间。
  DOORS & AISLES: Check door security and keep access clear.
□ 安全器材：检查固定、封识与检查记录。
  SAFETY EQUIPMENT: Check restraints, seals and inspection records.

二、途中记录 / EN-ROUTE NOTES
时间 TIME ______  区间 SECTION ______
现象 OBSERVATION __________________
处置 ACTION _______________________

三、交接 / HANDOVER
未结事项 OUTSTANDING ITEMS __________
交班 CREW OUT ______  接班 CREW IN ______

留存于随车资料夹。 / KEEP IN THE ONBOARD DOCUMENT CLIPBOARD.
